review_pass_1.evidence: Both official CSIR PDFs checked at Unit 5.D; MP SET 2024 third-party syllabus copy inspected. Classical mutant identities, localized QC effect, auxin response versus concentration, PLT timescales, SHR mobility and WOX5 distal maintenance cross-checked against primary abstracts and accessible reviews. Added embryonic hypophysis context, Mähönen and Sozzani sources; hypothetical quantitative examples explicitly labeled. Recomputed 500, 250 µm/h; 138.63, 207.94, 69.31 and 91.63 µm; labeling indices 30%, 2%.

review_pass_2.evidence: Compared with actual published 5.C.05 (14,222 genuine teaching words). Draft contains connected anatomy-to-evidence-to-mechanism-to-reasoning progression; no exact duplicate prose. Added separate initial-topology figure, revised assertion-reason options, shuffled 50 answers and verified their position against displayed options. Practice, recall and traps separated from narrative.

quality.type: internal editorial assessment, not independent external peer review
quality.deductions: Selective full-text access and no external peer review; some teaching comparisons simplified; illustrative rather than empirical numerical datasets; questions not psychometrically calibrated; static DOM/reader checks without real browser interaction.

validation.concurrent_reconciliation: Initial candidate discarded after main advanced; latest main file/menu/checkpoint read and reconciled; adjacent reader code verified.
